tei:div.tei:p: rat+na'i gur drag gtor bzlog la/ hrīḥsngon= chab/ spos/ rnying sngon skyabs 'gro/ bde gshegs rgyal ba= sems bskyed/ yan bdun/ dkar bgegs/ las byang*/ bgegs bskrad nas bstod bshags yan/ brgyud 'debs/ dzapra bskul/ zhi ba stong*/ drag po stong*/ 'khor sngags brgya/ srung 'khor nyer gcig las bzhi gsum/ stong tshig mchod bstod/ spu gri las mdun bskyed/ mchod pa yan/ rang byung lhun grub= bstod/ bsnyen pa cung zad/ ya ma tha tu= sogs/ las sngags/ brgya'am nyar gcig mchod bstod/ gsol ka sde bdun/ zhing skyong*/ spu gri gsum/ bsnyo kha/ tshogs 'grigs nang skong ba rgyas pa dri med shel phreng*/ bka' srung rnams skong ba bsdu na/ rang gzhung*/ bar bshags bcas/ spu gri'i brub bskyed/ 'gugs pa gsum/ bden chung bzhi/ rtsa brgyud gsum/ bsgral las/ zhal bstab/ gtor 'bul bcas mthar dbyung*/ spron 'dir bstod bskul rnam rgyal 'bar ma gtang*/ gtor bzlog mtshon cha'i 'khor lo/ bzlog phran gter gzhung yin nges dpe 'dug na cung zad re gtang*/ nub mo drang lhag bskul chad brtan/ tshe 'gugs nas rgyal dkyil yan/ zor 'phang nyin bzlog pa'i mthar/ zab mdo bdud bzlog bcas/ sgo dbye 556) bzlog mtha'i/ bh+yoḥ pho brang nang gi= bi li ma'i/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob= lta bus dngos grub blang*/ gtor lha ye shes pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ gtor snod bhan+dha= rtsa brgyud bskul pa rngam brjid stobs ldan lta bu/ spro na chos skyong rnams bskul/ ye thog ra dge chad tho/ ri khar/ dkar gtor/ za lam/ bzlog mtha'i/ bh+yoḥ da ni zor gyi= dgra la bh+yoḥ brub bskyed/ 'gugs pa rnams phur thun/ bzlog mtha'i/ gtor zor gnyen po= 'di pa tshar bzhi bor la zor rnams 'phang*/ dmigs pa dang sngags brjod/ brtan ma/ bro mnan/ nang du rgyal rtags/ dus gsum bde gshegs= tshe 'gugs/ dngos grub/ mchod bstod/ bkra shis rgyun mchod bar/
he pa'i lhan thabs ltar mthar dbyung ngo*/ ces pa'ang thub bstan chos kyi glang pos bris pa dge legs 'phel/ maṅga laṃ//
